scope: Android direct MiBand-Converter source port with CHIPS persistence and foreground capture notification

validation.capture_transport: Direct ported-manager callback/state/socket tests plus injected CHIPS service transport; no sustained real band reception claimed

BLE measurement and OSC wire encoding
Actual OSC UDP delivery to localhost
Repeated unchanged HR values retain exact reception times in bounded compressed runs
Session reopen, connection events, late-callback rejection and cascade deletion
Interrupted sessions end at last committed sample; recovery resumes the same session with an explicit gap event
Ongoing/private foreground notification and content handoff
Screen-off sample saving with foreground service active
Notification Reconnect and Stop
Activity recreation and duplicate Start preserve capture identity
Ported converter state machine transitions
Original raw sample hook before unchanged-HR/UI filtering, stale-GATT rejection

validation.rerun_note: An existing assistant-settings intent test had one emulator window-focus failure; isolated rerun and subsequent complete 67- and final 68-test runs passed without changing that test.

os_process_death_check.method: Isolated API 37 emulator: active real foreground service with synthetic band address, app process killed with SIGKILL; no real band measurements claimed

remaining: Real Smart Band 10 Share HR reception and sample cadence on Poco

storage: Lossless equal-value runs; database batches every 2 seconds or 32 measurements. Abrupt process loss can discard the last roughly 2 seconds of uncommitted samples.
